threads.body: Groq 1.7.0 returns default streaming token counts in `chunk.x_groq.usage`; top-level `chunk.usage` requires `stream_options.include_usage`, which this call does not request. Streams using the default response format therefore skip the new token attributes and measurements. Read `x_groq.usage` as a fallback while preserving usage from earlier chunks.
